profile.headline: Senior Technical Solutions Engineer at SECUTIX
profile.summary:
I'm a full-stack engineer with 4+ years delivering production software  at enterprise scale. At Dimagi, I architected healthcare applications  for state government agencies — including the Colorado and New Jersey  Departments of Health — serving millions of residents across critical  public health programs. I also built a QA automation tool that  compressed testing cycles from 2–3 days to under 4 hours.  

Outside of that, I'm the founder and sole engineer behind Creole Pale —  a Haitian Creole audio dictionary and language learning platform built  on Django, PostgreSQL, and AWS. Designed and shipped the full stack from  scratch, live in production.  

What I bring: 
• End-to-end technical delivery — requirements through production support 
• Backend engineering: Python, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, AWS 
• Integration design: APIs, third-party systems, data pipelines 
• Enterprise client delivery: government agencies, healthcare orgs, nonprofits 

Currently seeking remote Implementation Engineer, Solutions Engineer or Backend Engineer roles. Open to connecting.

positions.title: Founder & Full-Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Architected and deployed a scalable SaaS platform (Django, PostgreSQL) with a custom REST API and secure user authentication, live in production.

Built advanced search functionality with partial and fuzzy matching using PostgreSQL, improving language accessibility for non-fluent Haitian Creole learners.

Developed responsive front-end interfaces using JavaScript and React, implementing dynamic search and audio playback UX.

Implemented AWS S3 for cloud-based audio storage and delivery, and optimized PostgreSQL schema for scalable query performance.

Configured continuous deployment pipeline via Render/GitHub Actions, enabling automatic production deploys on every push.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Django · PostgreSQL · Amazon S3 · JavaScript

positions.title: Senior Technical Project Analyst (Technical Solutions)
positions.description:
During this tenure, I worked from end-end throughout the software development lifecycle,
delivering advanced CommCare solutions by configuring technical requirements defined by clients and project teams, through UAT testing and deployment. My work also involves engineering complex form logic, validating automated data-update rules, piloting SMS-based community surveys, and resolving intricate calculation issues. I carefully evaluate requirements to uncover hidden technical risks and identify opportunities for innovation. To improve insights, I analyze facility app usage data with advanced tools, tracking compliance patterns tied to factors such as device utilization and email notification effectiveness.

I also developed and deployed a Python-based QA automation tool that enhanced team efficiency,
accelerated process execution, and significantly reduced manual effort. By coordinating with cross-
functional team members, I streamline communication, ensure workflow clarity, and quickly remove
obstacles to maintain project momentum. In addition to these efforts, I produce comprehensive
documentation—including process maps, workflow diagrams, use cases, and requirements—that
strengthens project implementation and ensures stakeholder alignment.

The QA automation tool I developed cut QA cycle times from 2–3 days down to just a few hours, significantly accelerating release speed and improving overall quality. I also presented actionable insights that guided app enhancements, leading to a 10%+ increase in facility compliance with Colorado’s Behavioral Health Administration requirements. On the technical side, I redesigned app queries to leverage indexed fields, which eliminated performance bottlenecks and ensured accurate data retrieval. These optimizations improved system performance by cutting query times and boosting page load speeds by over 30%, resulting in a smoother, more reliable user experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Solutions · SQL · Healthcare Information Technology (HIT) · Implementation Engineer · Solution Architecture · Test Automation Frameworks

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
As a Web Developer at Savannah Latin Dance, I engineered a class management application by integrating multiple microservices into a unified system, ensuring scalability and seamless functionality. To sustain application reliability, I maintained clean code, debugged complex issues, and executed performance optimization tests. I implemented Firebase authentication and cloud database solutions, which streamlined client account tracking and simplified ongoing maintenance.

In addition to application development, I accelerated website performance by 60% by migrating content from WordPress to a React-based web application. I also launched a fully functional e-commerce platform that enhanced brand visibility and drove online sales of products and services.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Solutions · Healthcare Information Technology (HIT) · Software Development · Web Application Development · Full-Stack Development · Solution Architecture

positions.title: Community Health Educator
positions.description: In this role, I spearheaded a joint initiative to strengthen healthcare delivery in resource-limited settings,training 20 community health workers over a two-year period. I drew on cultural competency and interpersonal relationship-building skills gained through extensive training to foster trust and establish seamless collaboration with local communities and stakeholders. Through this work, I partnered with community organizations to deliver youth education programs on sexual and reproductive health, which helped drive a 50% reduction in teenage pregnancy within two years. I also contributed to reducing childhood malnutrition rates in the target population by 16% through targeted, community-focused health interventions.

projects.title: Colorado Behavioral Health Administration
projects.description: I designed and developed the Provider Services application supporting statewide behavioral health delivery, enabling thousands of residents to access critical mental health services. I created new application features and functionality through iterative design work, implemented advanced requirements such as conditional alerts and referral workflows to streamline provider operations, and proactively monitored system health while escalating issues via Sentry to minimize downtime. I also directed the creation and execution of the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) plan, ensuring deployment readiness.

projects.title: Alameda County, CA
projects.description: I directed requirements analysis sessions with project partners to clarify priorities and define deliverables. I established technical strategies for application enhancements, structured testing approaches, and executed enhancements aligned with technical specifications to strengthen system functionality. To ensure smooth implementation and knowledge transfer, I authored comprehensive technical documentation.
